dedupe_keys.name: provincial food demand dataset for china 2002 2020

description: This dataset estimates annual grain demand for 31 Chinese provinces (excluding Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) from 2002 to 2020, split into urban and rural food consumption, feed grain, seed grain, industrial use, waste and loss, and grain for storage. The Science Data Bank record says the estimates are based on statistical data and account for spatial and temporal differences in farming practices. Version V1 was published on 20 May 2025 by Chen Mulin, Yang Linsheng and Li Hairong as one file of about 57 KB, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with a Chinese-language description and national coverage by province. Caveats: values are modelled from statistics, not measured flows, and the file format is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives provincial grain demand to balance against production in food supply chain models, and to test how transport or harvest disruptions leave provinces short. Related catalogue records include the ChinaCropPhen1km crop phenology data and FAOSTAT.
name: Provincial food demand dataset for China, 2002-2020
